title: Longest Common Prefix
statement: Return the longest common prefix shared by every string in `strs`. If there is none, return an empty string.
hints: Horizontal scanning: start with the first string and trim it against each later string.
Vertical scanning: compare column i of every string until one disagrees or ends.
A trie also works. For this input size it is unnecessary machinery.

approaches.name: Sort and compare the extremes
approaches.explanation: The common prefix of the whole set is the common prefix of the first and last strings after sorting.

approaches.name: Vertical scan
approaches.explanation: Stop at the first mismatched column.

editorial: Take the first string as the candidate prefix. For each later string, shorten the candidate until that string starts with it. If the candidate becomes empty, return immediately. The vertical scan is equivalent and makes the column-wise disagreement obvious.
